fusions.name: Sleeve Dart
fusions.desc: Flicks a blade from your sleeve that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. It has 40% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Cloak and Dagger
fusions.desc: Whips your cloak across a cone 3 tiles ahead with the blade behind it, dealing 12 damage, stunning each enemy for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Field Sutures
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you, 8% more for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Stitched-In Sheaths
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 6%, and your dodge chance by 4%.
